s.note: the bowling alleys on the road
s.how: Bake 1kg frozen chips. Brown 300g beef mince with 1 tbsp chilli powder and 200g tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes. Spoon over the chips and top with 100g cheese.
Slice a fresh white loaf thickly. Serve with 100g soft butter and a jar of apple butter or apple sauce. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.how: Simmer 1kg chicken thighs in 1.5L stock for 30 minutes, shred and return. Add 300g thick egg noodles and cook 10 minutes. Serve over 800g mashed potatoes.

w.how: Rub 150g flour, 100g brown sugar and 60g butter into crumbs. Mix 150ml molasses, 1 egg, 1 tsp bicarb and 180ml hot water. Pour into a 23cm pastry case, top with crumbs and bake at 180C for 35 minutes.

d.how: Pour 1L cold full cream milk into 4 glasses. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold. Keep a second round ready for the back half of the film.
